subject: Appropriate model for bruvo.dist with diploids?

messages.author: 1732832dee19d6c1
messages.subject: Appropriate model for bruvo.dist with diploids?
parts:
I have a dataset with a large number of individuals (~1000) genotyped with SSR markers, which includes some missing data.  Because of the missing data and stepwise mutation model, I think Bruvo's distance could be the most appropriate method of calculating genetic distance, but what would be the appropriate model setting given that all of my individuals are known diploids?  In this case should I just use Prevosti's distance instead?  

Thank you for any guidance!

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Appropriate model for bruvo.dist with diploids?
parts:
Hi, 

Bruvo’s distance is also appropriate for diploids. That being said, the models will only account for ambiguity in allele dosage, not missing data; Bruvo’s distance will ignore any comparisons of missing data (taking the average distance across all typed loci between individuals). 

When you use Bruvo’s distance, pay careful attention to the repeat lengths you specify and use the fix_replen() function to make sure you don’t end up with any ambiguous repeats due to rounding errors. 

Best,
Zhian
